title: In Charge of the Outside Work

request.style: English, male baritone solo with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, piano, upright bass, drums, timpani, reverent and solemn, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the fourth day they weighed the silver
Gold and vessels in the house of our God
Into the hands of the priests they went
With the Levites standing close by

[Pre-Chorus]
Jozabad son of Jeshua was there
Noadiah son of Binnui too
Weighing out what was brought from exile
Recording all that the people gave

[Chorus]
In charge of the outside work
Of the house of God he stood
Keeping the charge of his God
As the singers and gatekeepers did

[Verse]
The Levites explained the Law
While the people remained in their places
Jeshua Bani Sherebiah
Jamin Akkub Shabbethai Hodiah

[Pre-Chorus]
Maaseiah Kelita Azariah
Jozabad Hanan and Pelaiah
They made the words plain and clear
To the assembly gathered there

[Chorus]
In charge of the outside work
Of the house of God he stood
Keeping the charge of his God
As the singers and gatekeepers did

[Bridge]
Shabbethai and Jozabad stood
Two heads of the Levites
Managing the daily service
Of the temple life they led

[Outro]
According to the command
Of David and Solomon
They kept the charge of purity
In the house of our God
